era: 约 150 年生于南印度婆罗门家庭（一说安达罗国）——传说出身婆罗门而皈依佛教，据说由龙宫取出《大方广佛华严经》而号'龙树'——学成后一度以'憍慢'自居欲自立教团，传说大龙（一说老比丘）接引入深宫读大乘经而悔悟——确立'中观'（Madhyamaka）纲领：一切法缘起无自性（sunyata，空），执有执无皆为戏论，中道即是缘起——以归谬论证（prasanga）遍破'说一切有'部的实在论、数论的因中有果与胜论的因中无果，把'自性'（svabhava）概念推上审判台——著《中论》（Mulamadhyamakakarika，四百四十八颂二十七品）、《六十如理论》《七十空性论》《十二门论》《回诤论》《大智度论》（十万颂，汉译存三十四卷）等，被尊为'千部论主'——传说寿逾数百岁，后为王子求头（一说因与王室之约）以吉祥草叶自断其首而逝——身后中观成为大乘佛教义学的轴心：提婆、佛护、月称、清辨数代接续，经鸠摩罗什入汉地开三论宗，经寂护入藏地成应成传统，《楞伽经》授记其为'证得欢喜地'之菩萨，禅、净、天台、华严、三论、密诸宗共尊为'八宗共祖'
era_en: Born c. 150 in South India into a Brahmin family (some say in the Andhra country)—by legend a Brahmin convert to Buddhism who fetched the Avatamsaka Sutra from the palace of the nagas and took the name 'Nagarjuna'—after mastery he once stood in 'pride,' intending to found his own order, until by legend a great naga (some say an old monk) led him into a palace to read the Mahayana sutras and he repented—gave the Middle Way (Madhyamaka) its program: all things arise dependently without intrinsic nature (sunyata, emptiness), clinging to being or non-being is proliferation, and the middle way is dependent origination itself—with reductio argument (prasanga) he refuted the Sarvastivada realism, the Samkhya 'effect pre-exists in the cause' and the Vaisesika 'effect is wholly new,' putting the concept of intrinsic nature (svabhava) on trial—wrote the Mulamadhyamakakarika (448 verses in 27 chapters), the Sixty Stanzas of Reasoning, the Seventy Stanzas on Emptiness, the Twelve Gates Treatise, the Vigrahavyavartani, and the Mahaprajnaparamitopadesa (100,000 stanzas, 34 fascicles in Chinese), honored as 'author of a thousand treatises'—by legend lived several hundred years and at the end, when a prince sought his head (some say by a pact with the royal house), severed it himself with a blade of kusa grass—after his death Madhyamaka became the axis of Mahayana doctrine: Aryadeva, Buddhapalita, Candrakirti and Bhavaviveka continued in succession; through Kumarajiva it entered China as the Three Treatise school, through Santaraksita Tibet as the Prasangika tradition; the Lankavatara Sutra prophesied him a bodhisattva at the stage of Joy, and the Chan, Pure Land, Tiantai, Huayan, Sanlun and Tantric schools honor him together as 'common ancestor of the eight schools'
school: 中观学派的开山祖师（'缘起性空'形上学总纲的立法者）/ 归谬论证（应成）的发明者（不立自宗、以对手前提推出自毁）/ 大乘经典的整理与弘扬者（据说自龙宫迎出《华严》并广造诸论）/ 二谛学说的立法者（世俗谛与究竟谛的两层真值架构）/ 被尊为'第二佛陀'与'八宗共祖'的传承源头
historical_significance: 龙树（约150-250），南印度人，大乘佛教中观学派的创始人，被后世尊为'第二佛陀'。他的历史地位由五件事锚定。其一，'缘起性空'总纲的确立：他把佛陀的'缘起'教义锻造成完整的形上学体系——'众因缘生法，我说即是空'：凡依因缘而起者即无自性（svabhava），空不是无物而是'无自性'的别名，且'以有空义故，一切法得成'——唯有无自性，因果、修行、言说才可能。其二，归谬论证方法（应成）的立法：不立自宗、只用对手前提推出其自毁——'我无有少宗故，我即为无过'——中观由此成为史上罕见的'不占位置的批判系统'。其三，对'自性'概念的审判：自生、他生、共生、无因生四门俱破，'一'与'异'俱不成，把印度各派形上学的共同预设掀翻。其四，二谛学说：世俗谛（约定有效）与究竟谛（无自性可得）的两层架构，'不依世俗谛，不得第一义'——既保住日常世界的有效性，又为空性开出言说通道。其五，制度性影响：著作经鸠摩罗什等译入汉地开三论宗，经寂护入藏地成格鲁派义学根基；禅宗、净土、天台、华严、密教共尊其为'八宗共祖'，《楞伽经》授记其为登地菩萨——一个哲学体系在两大文明圈获得千年建制，史上罕见。代价与极限：'只破不立'使体系依赖后学补足（应成与自续的千年方法论之争）；'空'屡被误读为虚无主义（他本人警告'空被错误把握如抓蛇不当'）；生平资料多与传说混融（龙宫取经、寿逾数百、施头而逝），史实层仅能锚定其著述与思想影响。
historical_significance_en: Nagarjuna (c. 150-250), a South Indian and the founder of the Madhyamaka school of Mahayana Buddhism, is honored as the 'second Buddha.' Five achievements anchor his standing. First, the program 'dependent origination is emptiness': he forged the Buddha's teaching of conditioned arising into a complete metaphysics—'whatever is dependently arisen, that I declare to be emptiness': whatever arises from conditions lacks intrinsic nature (svabhava); emptiness is not nothing but another name for the absence of intrinsic nature, and 'for whom emptiness is possible, everything is possible'—only without fixed essence can causation, practice and speech work. Second, the reductio method (prasanga): establishing no thesis of his own, he drew self-destruction from his opponents' premises—'since I assert no thesis, I alone am without fault'—making Madhyamaka a rare critical system that occupies no position. Third, the trial of 'intrinsic nature': arising from self, other, both and causeless all refuted; identity and difference both dissolved—the shared presupposition of Indian metaphysics overturned. Fourth, the two truths: the two-level architecture of conventional validity and ultimate emptiness, 'without the conventional the ultimate cannot be taught'—preserving the everyday world while opening a channel of speech for emptiness. Fifth, institutional influence: his works entered China through Kumarajiva (the Sanlun school) and Tibet through Santaraksita (the Geluk doctrinal foundation); Chan, Pure Land, Tiantai, Huayan and the Tantric schools honor him as 'common ancestor of the eight schools,' and the Lankavatara prophesied him a bodhisattva on the path—a philosophical system holding institutional life across two civilizations for a millennium, rarely matched. Costs and limits: 'refute only, never establish' left the system to be completed by successors (the millennium-long Prasangika-Svatantrika dispute); 'emptiness' was repeatedly misread as nihilism (he himself warned 'emptiness wrongly grasped is like a snake seized by the wrong end'); his biography fuses with legend (fetching sutras from the naga realm, centuries of life, yielding his head)—the historical layer is anchored only in his works and their influence.
unique_thinking: 他思维方式的底色是'缘起为刃、归谬为器：任何事物若被追问到底，其'独立自足'即告瓦解；而瓦解不是虚无——依起本身就是事物的全部存在方式'。六个标志性动作。其一，'缘起归空法'——对任何事物追问'它依什么而立'，凡依因缘和合而起者即无自性：依起与自性逻辑上不两立。其二，'四句破法'——穷举任何形上学命题的四种可能（有/无/双是/双非）并逐一归谬，且不立任何宗，包括'一切皆空'。其三，'假名施设法'——万物'但名'而立：名不指实（无自性可指）但名不虚设（依起故有用），假名不是缺陷而是事物唯一的存在方式。其四，'二谛分层法'——真值分层为世俗谛与究竟谛，两层不混不裂：'不依世俗谛，不得第一义'，世俗不因究竟空性而失效。其五，'一体异体破法'——对任何'整体-部分'或'能-所'结构逐一检验'是一'与'是异'并证明皆不成：同则失分位、异则失依存。其六，'空亦复空法'——把'空'本身也交还依起：'若复见有空，诸佛所不化'——体系必须吞下自身方为自洽。代价与极限：纯驳回不立论使制度建设依赖后学；'中道'易被庸俗化为折中主义（真中道的试金石是触到两极共同预设）；对'自性'的严格定义是全部论证的地基，定义被松动则归空力度减弱。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of his thinking: dependent origination as the blade, reductio as the engine—any thing, pursued to its root, loses its 'independent self-sufficiency'; and the loss is not nihilism, for dependence is the whole of how things exist. Six signature moves. First, dependence-as-emptiness—of any thing ask 'on what does it stand': whatever arises from conditions lacks intrinsic nature; dependence and intrinsic nature are logically incompatible. Second, the tetralemma—enumerate the four possible positions on any metaphysical proposition (is / is not / both / neither) and refute each by reductio, asserting no thesis, not even 'all is empty.' Third, dependent designation—things stand as 'mere name': names point to no substance (none exists) yet are not idle (dependence gives them use); designation is not a defect but the only mode of existence. Fourth, the two truths—truth stratified into conventional and ultimate, neither merged nor split: 'without the conventional the ultimate cannot be taught,' and the everyday is not voided by ultimate emptiness. Fifth, identity-difference dissolution—of any whole-part or agent-patient structure test both 'identical' and 'different' and show neither holds: identity destroys the distinction, difference destroys the dependence. Sixth, emptiness of emptiness—hand 'emptiness' itself back to dependence: 'one who then sees emptiness as a view is beyond the Buddhas' healing'—a system is consistent only when it swallows itself. Costs and limits: pure refutation left institution-building to successors; the 'middle way' vulgarizes easily into compromise (the touchstone is touching the shared presupposition of the poles); the strict definition of 'intrinsic nature' is the foundation of every argument—loosen it and the reduction weakens.

name_zh: 本体解构方法论/对任何事物追问'它依什么而立'，凡依因缘和合而起者即无自性（svabhava）——'众因缘生法，我说即是空'：依起与自性逻辑上不两立，指出依起即是指出空
name_en: ontological-deconstruction methodology/ask of any thing 'on what does it stand': whatever arises in dependence on causes and conditions lacks intrinsic nature (svabhava)—'whatever is dependently arisen, that I declare to be emptiness': dependence and intrinsic nature are logically incompatible, so to show dependence is to show emptiness
category: 本体解构方法论/对任何事物追问'它依什么而立'，凡依因缘和合而起者即无自性（svabhava）——'众因缘生法，我说即是空'：依起与自性逻辑上不两立，指出依起即是指出空
modes.domain_zh: 《中论》第十八品与第二十四品是此法的完整立法。龙树把佛陀的'缘起'教义锻造成一把形上学的手术刀：一个东西若有'自性'（svabhava，凭自身而立、不依他者的本性），它就不需要生起——自性之物不造、不待、不变；而凡是我们实际经验到的事物，无一不依因缘而生、依部分而立、依概念而名。两难由此收口：要么自性而无需生起（与经验不符），要么依起而无自性（结论：空）。所以空不是'无物'，而是'无自性之物'的另一个名字——'以有空义故，一切法得成'：正因为无自性，事物才能变化、才能起作用、才能被认知；若万物各有凝固自性，因果、修行、言说全部不可能。这是龙树最锋利的一次概念反转：对手以为'空'摧毁世界，龙树证明只有'空'才让世界可能。代价与极限：'依起即空'的推理依赖对'自性'概念的严格界定，若对手换一种较弱的'自性'定义（如中观自续派所许的'名言自性'），归空的力度就减弱；且此法若停留在逻辑推演而不与'二谛'（M-NAG-004）配套，容易被误读为虚无主义——龙树自己警告'空被错误把握，如同被错误一端抓住的蛇'。
modes.domain_en: Chapter 18 and chapter 24 of the Mulamadhyamakakarika are the founding legislation of this method. Nagarjuna forges the Buddha's teaching of dependent origination into a metaphysical scalpel: if a thing had intrinsic nature (svabhava—standing by itself, not depending on anything), it would not need to arise—an intrinsically-natured thing is unmade, unconditioned, unchanging; yet everything we actually encounter arises depending on causes, stands depending on parts, is named depending on concepts. The dilemma closes: either intrinsic nature without arising (contrary to experience) or dependence without intrinsic nature (the conclusion: emptiness). Emptiness is therefore not 'nothing' but another name for 'things without intrinsic nature'—'for whom emptiness is possible, everything is possible': precisely because there is no fixed nature, things can change, function, and be known; if each thing held a frozen essence, causation, practice and speech would all be impossible. This is Nagarjuna's sharpest conceptual reversal: the opponent thinks emptiness destroys the world; Nagarjuna proves that only emptiness makes the world possible. Costs and limits: the inference from dependence to emptiness relies on a strict definition of 'intrinsic nature'; against a weaker definition (as the Svatantrika allowance of conventional natures), the force of the reduction weakens; and without the pairing with the two truths (M-NAG-004) the method slides toward nihilism—Nagarjuna himself warns that 'emptiness wrongly grasped is like a snake seized by the wrong end.'

modes.definition_en: Ontological-deconstruction methodology/ask of any thing 'on what does it stand': whatever arises dependently lacks intrinsic nature—emptiness is not nothing but another name for the absence of intrinsic nature: only because of emptiness can anything stand

modes.key_quote_zh: 众因缘生法，我说即是空，亦为是假名，亦是中道义。
modes.key_quote_en: Whatever is dependently co-arisen, that I declare to be emptiness; it is also a dependent designation, and precisely that is the middle way.
process_zh: 对对象提出依起问句：'它凭自身而立，还是依因缘、部分与概念而立？'——逐项列出其依存条件
施加两难：若它有自性（凭自身而立），则不需生起、不需条件、不应变化——与经验矛盾；若它依条件而起，则无自性
完成反转：宣告'空'不是消灭对象，而是对象'无自性'的别名——并论证唯有无自性，对象的因果作用与可认知性才成立
自噬收口：把'空'本身也交还依起——空是依'执有'而立的方便假名，不可再实体化为一个'最高真理'
process_en: Put the dependence question to the object: 'does it stand by itself, or on causes, parts and concepts?'—list its conditions of dependence

Apply the dilemma: if it has intrinsic nature (standing by itself), it needs no arising, no conditions, no change—contrary to experience; if it arises depending on conditions, it lacks intrinsic nature
Complete the reversal: declare that emptiness does not abolish the object but names its absence of intrinsic nature—and argue that only thus can the object's causal efficacy and knowability hold
Close by self-consumption: hand emptiness itself back to dependence—emptiness is a provisional designation standing on the reification of 'things,' not to be reified as a highest truth
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》第24品：'众因缘生法，我说即是空'——缘起与空同一的总立法，也是全书唯一一次把'空'正面定义
'以有空义故，一切法得成'——对'空摧毁世界'指控的最强反驳：若无自性，因果、四谛、修行才可能；若各有自性，一切皆不可能
观因果品：'因中有果'与'因中无果'双遣——生本身依起而空，两条传统因果解释路线被同一把刀放下
representative_cases_en: MMK chapter 24: 'whatever is dependently co-arisen, that I declare to be emptiness'—the founding identification of dependence with emptiness, the only positive definition of emptiness in the work

'For whom emptiness is possible, everything is possible'—the strongest reply to the charge that emptiness destroys the world: without intrinsic nature causation, the four truths and practice are possible; with fixed essences, nothing is

The examination of causation: both 'the effect pre-exists in the cause' and 'it does not' are let fall—arising itself is empty of intrinsic nature, and two traditional accounts of causation are cut by the same blade
modern_applications_zh: 本质主义审计：对任何'核心本质'话语（核心竞争力、民族性、人性）追问'它依什么条件而立'——依存条件一变，所谓本质即变，凝固的本质论多是把一段依起关系误读为永恒属性
系统思维的哲学地基：系统动力学讲'结构决定行为'，龙树补上反向一刀——结构本身也是依起而立的，任何系统边界都是概念假名，建模前先空掉'系统有固定本质'的预设
创新方法论：'以有空义故，一切法得成'翻译成工程语言即'唯有放弃固化设计，系统才能演化'——过度锁定规格的产品无法迭代，空性是演化的形上学许可证
modern_applications_en: Essentialism audit: of any 'core essence' discourse (core competence, national character, human nature) ask 'on what conditions does it stand'—when the conditions shift, the 'essence' shifts; frozen essentialism usually misreads a dependence relation as an eternal property

The philosophical ground of systems thinking: system dynamics says structure determines behavior; Nagarjuna adds the reverse cut—structure itself is dependently arisen, every system boundary is a conceptual designation; before modeling, empty the assumption that the system has a fixed essence

Innovation methodology: 'for whom emptiness is possible, everything is possible' in engineering language reads 'only by releasing fixed design can a system evolve'—products over-locked to specs cannot iterate; emptiness is the metaphysical license for evolution

name_zh: 辩证方法论/对任何形上学命题穷举其全部四种可能（有/无/亦有亦无/非有非无）并逐一驳回——不是选边，而是证明命题本身在究竟层面不可成立
name_en: dialectical methodology/enumerate all four possible positions on any metaphysical proposition (is / is not / both / neither) and refute each—not to pick a side but to show the proposition itself cannot ultimately hold
category: 辩证方法论/对任何形上学命题穷举其全部四种可能（有/无/亦有亦无/非有非无）并逐一驳回——不是选边，而是证明命题本身在究竟层面不可成立
modes.domain_zh: 四句（catuskoti）是《中论》的论证引擎。龙树的对手们各执一端：数论执'有'（果在因中本有）、断灭论执'无'、部分学派执'亦有亦无'、方广道人执'非有非无'（拨无因果）。龙树的作法不是加入这场选边战，而是掀翻整个棋盘：对'如来灭后有无'、'自性与他性'、'去来'、'燃可燃'等核心问题，他把四种可能立场穷举出来，再用归谬逐一驳回——每一种立场若被严格贯彻都自我毁灭。关键在第三句与第四句的反直觉驳回：'亦有亦无'犯自语相违（同一对象同一层面不能既是有又是无）；'非有非无'看似超脱，实则仍以'有无'为坐标，是第四种执着而非执着的超越。最重要的示范是第十八品对'空'本身的自辩：'我无有少宗（主张）故，我即为无过'——四句破不立任何宗，包括'一切皆空'这个宗；'若我有少宗，我则有失'。这使中观成为史上罕见的'不占位置的批判系统'。代价与极限：四句破的穷举依赖'四种可能已穷尽'这个前提，若对手提出非标准的第五种逻辑（如否定性超越指称），四句框架需要扩展；且纯驳回不立论使中观在制度建设上依赖后学（月称、清辨）补足——'只破不立'既是力量也是把解释权让渡给注释者的弱点。
modes.domain_en: The tetralemma (catuskoti) is the argumentative engine of the Mulamadhyamakakarika. Nagarjuna's opponents each held one corner: the Samkhya held 'is' (the effect pre-exists in the cause), annihilationists held 'is not,' some schools held 'both,' and the nihilists held 'neither' (denying causation). Nagarjuna's move is not to join the corner-fight but to overturn the board: on the questions of whether the Tathagata exists after death, of self and other nature, of going and coming, of fire and fuel, he enumerates the four possible positions and refutes each by reductio—every position, strictly followed, destroys itself. The counterintuitive refutations are the third and fourth corners: 'both' commits self-contradiction (the same object at the same level cannot be both is and is not); 'neither' looks transcendent but still takes 'is/is not' as its coordinate—it is a fourth clinging, not the transcendence of clinging. The crucial demonstration is chapter 18's self-defense of emptiness: 'I have no thesis, therefore I alone am without fault; if I had any thesis, I would have a fault.' The tetralemma asserts nothing, including the thesis that 'all is empty'—making Madhyamaka a rare critical system that occupies no position. Costs and limits: the enumeration relies on the premise that four possibilities exhaust the field; a non-standard fifth logic (e.g. negative transcendent reference) would require extending the frame; and pure refutation without construction left institution-building to successors (Candrakirti, Bhavaviveka)—'refute only, establish nothing' is both the strength and the weakness of ceding interpretation to commentators.
modes.definition_zh: 辩证方法论/穷举任何形上学命题的四种可能（有/无/双是/双非）并逐一归谬驳回——不选边，而证明命题在究竟层面不可成立；且不立任何宗，包括'一切皆空'
modes.definition_en: Dialectical methodology/enumerate the four possible positions on any metaphysical proposition (is / is not / both / neither) and refute each by reductio—not picking a side but showing the proposition cannot ultimately hold; and asserting no thesis, not even 'all is empty'
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第1品观因缘、第10品观燃可燃、第15品观有无、第18品观我法（'我无有少宗故'）、第25品观涅槃（如来灭后四句）
key_concepts: 四句 catuskoti（有/无/亦有亦无/非有非无的穷举框架）
归谬驳回 prasanga（不立自宗、只以对手前提推出其自毁）
第三句自语相违（'亦是亦非'的同一层面矛盾）
第四句伪超越（'双非'仍以有无为坐标，是第四种执）
无宗无过 the thesisless critic（'若我有少宗，我则有失'）
modes.key_quote_zh: 若我有所立，则我有过失；我无所立故，我即无过失。
modes.key_quote_en: If I asserted any thesis, I would have a fault; since I assert no thesis, I alone am without fault.
process_zh: 把问题形式化为一个待决命题 P，并穷举其全部四种立场：P、非P、P且非P、非P且非非P
对每一立场从其内部前提推出归谬：执'有'者无法解释变化与生起，执'无'者自我拆台（断灭论若真则言说无效），执'双是'者自语相违，执'双非'者仍以有无为坐标
宣告结论不是第五种立场，而是'P 这类命题在究竟层面不可成立'——问题被消解而非被回答
自噬检验：检查自己是否暗中立宗——若'一切皆空'被执为宗，对空本身再施四句；'无宗'是此法免于自毁的唯一保险
process_en: Formalize the question as a proposition P and enumerate its four positions: P, not-P, both, neither

Derive a reductio from each position's own premises: holding 'is' cannot explain change and arising; holding 'is not' undermines itself (if nihilism were true, speech would fail); 'both' is self-contradictory; 'neither' still takes is/is-not as its coordinate
Declare that the conclusion is not a fifth position but that 'propositions of this type cannot ultimately hold'—the question is dissolved, not answered

Run the self-consumption check: examine whether a thesis has been smuggled in—if 'all is empty' is held as a thesis, apply the tetralemma to emptiness itself; 'no thesis' is the only insurance against self-destruction
representative_cases_zh: 观涅槃品：'如来灭后有/无/亦有亦无/非有非无'四句俱置——佛陀本人对此类问题保持圣默然，龙树把沉默论证化：四句不是尚未知道答案，而是问题本身范畴错置
观我法品第十八：'我无有少宗故，我即为无过'——把'不立宗'本身升格为方法论原则，中观由此成为'不占位置的批判系统'
观燃可燃品：燃者与可燃物'是一/是异'两俱不成——以'双是/双非'四句拆解一切'能所'结构的模板战例
representative_cases_en: The examination of nirvana: on whether the Tathagata exists after death—the four corners are all set aside; the Buddha's own noble silence on such questions is argumentativized: the corners are not unanswered but category-mistaken
Chapter 18: 'since I assert no thesis, I alone am without fault'—the elevation of thesislessness itself into a methodological principle, making Madhyamaka a critical system occupying no position
The examination of fire and fuel: burner and combustible are neither identical nor different—a template engagement where the four corners dismantle every 'agent-patient' structure
modern_applications_zh: 战略决策的选项审计：重大决策前问'我们的选项清单是否穷尽且是否共享一个错误前提'——四句破的当代形态是检查'若所有选项都自毁，问题本身是否提错了'
辩论与谈判训练：把对方与己方的立场穷举成四角并各自归谬，常能发现双方共享的范畴错置——谈判僵局多为'第三种没人选的框架'所解
AI 对齐与伦理框架评估：对任何伦理立场（义务论/后果论/德性论/混合论）逐一施压测试，检验'混合论'是否只是把矛盾摊平而非解决——四句破是框架审计的原型工具
modern_applications_en: Options audit in strategy: before a major decision ask 'does our option list exhaust the field, and do all options share a false premise'—the contemporary tetralemma is checking whether, if every option self-destructs, the question itself is misposed

Debate and negotiation training: enumerate both sides' positions into four corners and run reductio on each; often both share a category mistake—deadlocks dissolve through 'the third frame nobody picked'

AI alignment and ethical-framework assessment: stress-test any ethical stance (deontology/consequentialism/virtue/hybrid) corner by corner, checking whether the 'hybrid' merely flattens contradiction rather than resolving it—the tetralemma is the prototype audit tool for frameworks

name_zh: 语言哲学方法论/万物'但名'而立——事物除概念施设外别无实体，而假名不是缺陷，是事物唯一的存在方式：'有名无实'不是否定世界，而是描述世界如何成立
name_en: philosophy-of-language methodology/things stand as 'mere designation'—apart from conceptual imputation there is no entity, and designation is not a defect but the only mode in which things exist: 'name without substance' does not negate the world, it describes how the world stands
category: 语言哲学方法论/万物'但名'而立——事物除概念施设外别无实体，而假名不是缺陷，是事物唯一的存在方式：'有名无实'不是否定世界，而是描述世界如何成立
modes.domain_zh: 龙树的语言哲学在《中论》第24品集中立法：'空'与'缘起'都是'假名'（prajnapti）——依概念施设而立，依约定而起作用。这与两种流行立场都不同：实在论者认为语言逐词对应实体，名称抓着'名'背后的'实'；约定虚无主义者认为既然名无实指则一切言说皆妄。龙树开辟第三条路：名不指实（无自性可指），但名不虚设（依起故有用）——'言说与所指'的关系是依存关系而非映照关系。日常语言因此获得'世俗谛'的合法性：在不追问究竟的层面，'我'、'瓶'、'因果'完全有效；一旦追问'此名所指之自性为何'，名即失效——失效的不是名，而是那个不存在的'实'。此法最锋利的应用是解构'自我'：'我'是一个依五蕴施设的假名，如'车'依轮轴等支分而立——离蕴无我，即蕴亦无我（车非离支分有，亦非即支分有）——但假名之我不因此废除，世俗层面照样安立。代价与极限：假名与实在的界限本身是假名，'何时该追问究竟'没有形式化判据，实践中依赖师承判断；且'但名'易被庸俗化为'一切都是话语建构'的相对主义——龙树的假名始终挂在缘起上（依条件施设），与'话语即一切'的后现代立场有本质区别。
modes.domain_en: Nagarjuna's philosophy of language is legislated in chapter 24: both 'emptiness' and 'dependent origination' are prajnapti—established by conceptual imputation, functioning by convention. This differs from two popular stances: the realist holds that words map entities one-to-one, names grasping the 'substance' behind the 'name'; the conventional nihilist holds that since names lack referents all speech is false. Nagarjuna opens a third way: names do not point to substance (none exists to point at), yet names are not idle (dependence gives them use)—the relation of speech and referent is dependence, not mirroring. Ordinary language thereby gains the legitimacy of conventional truth: at the level where the ultimate is not being probed, 'self,' 'pot,' and 'causation' are fully valid; once asked 'what is the intrinsic nature this name denotes,' the name fails—and what fails is not the name but the nonexistent substance. The sharpest application deconstructs the self: 'self' is a designation imputed on the five aggregates, as 'chariot' is established on wheels and axle—no self apart from the aggregates, none identical with them either (the chariot is neither apart from nor identical with its parts)—yet the designation is not abolished; it stands conventionally. Costs and limits: the line between designation and reality is itself a designation, with no formal criterion for 'when to probe the ultimate,' leaving practice to lineage judgment; and 'mere designation' vulgarizes easily into the relativism that 'everything is discourse'—Nagarjuna's designations always hang on dependent origination (imputed depending on conditions), essentially apart from the postmodern claim that discourse is all.
modes.definition_zh: 语言哲学方法论/万物依概念施设而立，假名不是缺陷而是事物唯一的存在方式——名不指实（无自性可指）但名不虚设（依起故有用）
modes.definition_en: Philosophy-of-language methodology/things stand by conceptual imputation; designation is not a defect but the only mode of existence—names point to no substance (none exists) yet are not idle (dependence gives them use)
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第24品观四谛（'亦为是假名，亦是中道义'）、第22品观如来（车喻五蕴施设）、《回诤论》论能立与所言俱空
key_concepts: 假名 prajnapti（依约定施设而立的名称与概念）
但名而立 mere designation（除施设外别无实体，而施设有效）
名实关系即依存关系 name-referent as dependence（语言不映照实在而依实在的条件生作用）
车喻 the chariot simile（'我'依五蕴施设，如车依支分而立）
世俗安立 conventional establishment（假名在世俗层面的完全合法性）
modes.key_quote_zh: 离车无支分，离支分无车；我依五蕴立，如车依轮轴。
modes.key_quote_en: Apart from its parts there is no chariot, apart from the chariot no parts; the self is imputed on the aggregates as a chariot on its wheels and axle.
process_zh: 对对象作'但名检验'：除去全部概念施设，剩下什么？——若答案仍是另一层施设（而非某个非施设的核），对象即是纯假名
考察施设的依存条件：这个名依哪些支分、哪些约定、哪些语境而立——列出'名'的缘起谱系
双向排除：名所指之实既不在名外（离蕴无我），也不在名内（即蕴亦无我）——施设与所指的关系是依存而非同一或分离
按需安立：在世俗层面保留并使用该假名（不废除'我'与'车'），同时标记其无自性——用而不执，即是中道
process_en: Run the designation test on the object: strip away all conceptual imputation—what remains? If the answer is another layer of imputation (not a non-imputed core), the object is pure designation
Map the designation's conditions of dependence: on which parts, conventions, contexts does the name stand—trace the lineage of the name

Exclude both ways: the substance the name denotes is neither outside the name (no self apart from the aggregates) nor inside it (no self identical with them)—designation and referent relate by dependence, not identity or separation
Establish as needed: retain and use the designation conventionally (do not abolish 'self' or 'chariot') while marking its lack of intrinsic nature—use without clinging, which is the middle way
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》观如来品：'如来'依五蕴施设，'即蕴/离蕴/依蕴/蕴依如来'五种关系全部不成——但'如来'假名照常安立，宗教敬仰不受影响
第24品把'空'自己也判为假名——'空'若不是假名就会成为新的'自性'，整个体系因此自洽
对'自我'的车喻分析：世俗层面'我在走路'完全有效，究竟层面'我'不可得——一句话内两层真值并行不悖，是日常语言分析的千年先声
representative_cases_en: The examination of the Tathagata: 'Tathagata' is imputed on the aggregates, and all five relations (identity with, apart from, possessing, depending) fail—yet the designation stands, and religious devotion is untouched
Chapter 24's verdict that 'emptiness' itself is a designation—if emptiness were not a designation it would become a new intrinsic nature, keeping the system self-consistent

The chariot analysis of the self: conventionally 'I am walking' is fully valid; ultimately no self is found—two truth-values in one sentence without collision, a millennia-early prefiguration of ordinary-language analysis
modern_applications_zh: 组织命名与身份治理：职位、头衔、KPI 全是假名施设——用而不执：岗位有效（世俗），但把岗位当'实体'（职位即人、头衔即价值）必生组织病
产品与品牌策略：品牌是依用户认知条件施设的假名——依起故有力，但试图让品牌'占有本质'（品牌即品质的保证）则脱离缘起，营销神话多源于此误
法律与社会建构分析：'法人''货币''国界'皆为依约定施设而完全有效的假名——龙树框架比'社会建构主义'更精确：建构不等于任意，施设依条件而有约束力
modern_applications_en: Organizational naming and identity governance: titles, roles and KPIs are designations—use without clinging: the role is valid conventionally, but treating it as an entity (the post is the person, the title the worth) breeds organizational pathology

Product and brand strategy: a brand is a designation imputed on the conditions of user cognition—powerful because dependent, yet asking the brand to 'own an essence' (the brand guarantees quality) departs from dependence; marketing myths are born of this error

Legal and social-construction analysis: 'legal person,' 'money,' 'border' are conventionally imputed and fully valid designations—Nagarjuna's frame is more precise than social constructivism: constructed does not mean arbitrary; imputations bind because they depend on conditions

name_zh: 认识论方法论/把真值分层为世俗谛（约定有效）与究竟谛（无自性可得），两层不混不裂：'不依世俗谛，不得第一义'——究竟真理必须借世俗语言施设才能被教授，而世俗日常不因究竟空性而失效
name_en: epistemological methodology/stratify truth into the conventional (valid by agreement) and the ultimate (no intrinsic nature found); the two neither merge nor split: 'without relying on the conventional, the ultimate cannot be taught'—ultimate truth must be taught through conventional language, and everyday life is not voided by ultimate emptiness
category: 认识论方法论/把真值分层为世俗谛（约定有效）与究竟谛（无自性可得），两层不混不裂：'不依世俗谛，不得第一义'——究竟真理必须借世俗语言施设才能被教授，而世俗日常不因究竟空性而失效
modes.domain_zh: 《中论》第24品第8-10颂是二谛的立法文本。龙树面对的致命指控是：'若一切皆空，则四谛、因果、修行皆毁'（无及于世，则坏于真谛）。二谛分层是他的总回答：冲突不是'空'与'有'之争，而是两层真值的混淆。世俗谛层面，因果、四谛、伦理、语言全部有效——佛也用'我'与'取'言说；究竟谛层面，这一切皆无自性可得。两条操作规则使分层不塌陷：其一，'不依世俗谛，不得第一义'——通往究竟的阶梯必须用世俗材料搭建（借假修真），不存在绕过语言的直接通道；其二，世俗不因究竟而废——'得无所得'不会让饭不香、债不免，空性不取消日常义务，只取消对日常的实体化执取。此法是佛教内部空有之争的仲裁器，也被后世（如月称对'世俗谛分正倒'）继续精化。代价与极限：两层之间的换算规则无法形式化——'何时用哪层'是判断而非算法，这为滥用开了门（以究竟谛逃避世俗责任的'恶取空'，或以世俗谛拒绝究竟审视的僵化实在论）；龙树未给世俗谛内部再分层的标准，倒向各派注释者各自立法。
modes.domain_en: Verses 8-10 of MMK chapter 24 are the founding text of the two truths. Nagarjuna faced the lethal charge: 'if all is empty, the four truths, causation and practice are destroyed' (and with the world destroyed, the true is destroyed). The two-truths stratification is his total reply: the conflict is not between emptiness and being but a confusion of two truth-levels. Conventionally, causation, the four truths, ethics and language all hold—the Buddha too speaks of 'self' and 'grasping'; ultimately, none of it is found with intrinsic nature. Two operating rules keep the stratification from collapsing: first, 'without relying on the conventional, the ultimate cannot be taught'—the ladder to the ultimate must be built of conventional material (practice through the provisional); there is no direct channel bypassing language. Second, the conventional is not voided by the ultimate—'attaining non-attainment' neither blurs the rice nor cancels the debt; emptiness cancels not everyday obligation but the reifying clinging to the everyday. This method became the arbiter of Buddhist debates on emptiness and being, further refined by successors (Candrakirti's division of conventional truth into the correct and the mistaken). Costs and limits: the conversion rule between levels cannot be formalized—'when to use which' is judgment, not algorithm, leaving room for abuse ('wicked grasping of emptiness' fleeing worldly responsibility via the ultimate, or rigid realism refusing ultimate scrutiny via the conventional); Nagarjuna set no standard for subdividing the conventional, ceding legislation to each lineage of commentators.
modes.definition_zh: 认识论方法论/真值分层为世俗谛与究竟谛，两层不混不裂——究竟须借世俗施设方可教授，世俗不因究竟空性而失效；冲突多为层级错位而非事实之争
modes.definition_en: Epistemological methodology/truth stratified into conventional and ultimate, neither merged nor split—the ultimate is teachable only through conventional imputation, and the conventional is not voided by ultimate emptiness; conflicts are mostly level-mismatch, not factual dispute
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第24品观四谛第8-10颂（'诸佛依二谛，为众生说法'，'不依世俗谛，不得第一义'）；《大智度论》论二谛方便
key_concepts: 世俗谛 samvriti-satya（约定有效层：因果、伦理、语言）
究竟谛 paramartha-satya（无自性可得层：一切法空）
层级不混不裂 stratification without merge or split（两层各有管辖权）
借俗显真 the ladder rule（不依世俗谛不得第一义）
俗不废于真 the non-voiding rule（空性不取消日常义务）
modes.key_quote_zh: 诸佛依二谛，为众生说法：一以世俗谛，二第一义谛。若人不能知，分别于二谛，则于深佛法，不知真实义。
modes.key_quote_en: The Buddhas teach the Dharma relying on two truths: the conventional truth of the world and the ultimate truth. One who does not know how to distinguish them cannot know the profound reality in the Buddha's teaching.
process_zh: 识别争论双方各自站在哪一层：把每个命题标记为世俗谛操作（约定、实践、制度）或究竟谛操作（自性审查）
把'空与有之争'重写为层级错位：多数冲突是一方用究竟谛否证世俗命题、或另一方用世俗直觉抵御究竟审查——先纠层级再论内容
执行借俗显真：通往究竟的任何进路必须用世俗材料搭建（语言、概念、修行次第），并承认这些材料本身无自性
执行俗不废真：宣布究竟结论后逐项检查世俗义务是否仍有效——被取消的只是实体化执取，不是义务、因果与责任本身
process_en: Identify which level each side stands on: mark every proposition as conventional operation (agreement, practice, institution) or ultimate operation (intrinsic-nature scrutiny)

Rewrite the 'emptiness vs. being' dispute as level-mismatch: most conflicts are one side refuting conventional propositions with the ultimate, or the other resisting ultimate scrutiny with worldly intuition—correct the level before debating content
Apply the ladder rule: any route to the ultimate must be built of conventional material (language, concepts, stages of practice), and that material itself acknowledged as lacking intrinsic nature

Apply the non-voiding rule: after declaring an ultimate conclusion, check item by item that worldly obligations still hold—only reifying clinging is cancelled, not obligation, causation or responsibility itself
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》第24品的总答辩：对手说'空则坏四谛'，龙树答'恰恰是空才让四谛成立'——冲突被重写为层级错位，论辩由此翻盘
佛陀的日常言说：佛亦说'我'、说'众生'、说'取'——究竟证悟者仍完整使用世俗语言，是'俗不废真'的原始示范
月称分世俗谛为'正世俗/倒世俗'（眼见二月是倒）——二谛框架内部的再立法，显示此法的可扩展性
representative_cases_en: The grand defense of chapter 24: the opponent says emptiness destroys the four truths; Nagarjuna answers that only emptiness lets the four truths stand—the dispute is rewritten as level-mismatch and the debate turns
The Buddha's everyday speech: the Buddha too says 'I,' 'beings,' 'grasping'—the fully awakened one uses conventional language without remainder, the primal demonstration of non-voiding
Candrakirti divides conventional truth into the correct and the mistaken (the moon seen double is mistaken)—re-legislation inside the frame, showing its extensibility
modern_applications_zh: 科学主义与人文价值之争的仲裁：'物理学没有自由意志'（究竟层操作）与'我选择了道歉'（世俗层操作）各居其层——二谛分层法是不取消任何一层的标准工具
组织双重标准治理：公司章程（世俗谛）与'章程皆为临时约定'（究竟谛）并行——既维护规则效力，又防止规则被实体化为永恒教条
心理咨询与哲学咨询：来访者的'我是个失败者'在世俗层是有效叙事、在究竟层是无自性标签——分层处理避免'空谈化解一切'的无效安慰与'同层硬顶'的对立
modern_applications_en: Arbitrating scientism vs. humanistic values: 'physics has no free will' (ultimate-level operation) and 'I chose to apologize' (conventional-level operation) each hold at their level—the two truths are the standard tool that voids neither

Governance of organizational double standards: the charter (conventional) and 'all charters are provisional agreements' (ultimate) run in parallel—preserving the force of rules while blocking their reification into eternal dogma

Psychotherapy and philosophical counseling: the client's 'I am a failure' is a valid conventional narrative and an ultimate-level designation without intrinsic nature—leveling avoids both the empty comfort that dissolves everything and the head-on clash at one level

name_zh: 概念分析方法/对任何'整体-部分'或'能-所'结构，逐一检验'是一'与'是异'两种关系并证明皆不成立——同则失其分位，异则失其依存，于是该结构的实体性被拆除
name_en: conceptual-analysis methodology/for any whole-part or agent-patient structure, test both 'identical' and 'different' and show neither holds—identity destroys the distinction, difference destroys the dependence, and the structure's substantiality is dismantled
category: 概念分析方法/对任何'整体-部分'或'能-所'结构，逐一检验'是一'与'是异'两种关系并证明皆不成立——同则失其分位，异则失其依存，于是该结构的实体性被拆除
modes.domain_zh: 《中论》大量章节由同一组操作生成：取一对相依概念（燃者与可燃、去者与去法、作者与作业、我与五蕴），先问'它们是一体吗？'——若是，则二者的分位消失（燃者即是柴，'烧'这个动作失去主体与对象的分别，'我'即是蕴则蕴灭我灭，自我无从安立）；再问'是异体吗？'——若异，则二者彻底无关（离柴有燃者则燃者不燃，离蕴有我则我与身心无关，修行与解脱皆无对象）。两俱不成，则'关系'背后没有一个实体性的承担者——不是取消关系本身（世俗层面燃火照常、人照常修行），而是取消把关系实体化为两个（或一个）自性物的解读。此法是四句破（M-NAG-002）在'二元对偶'场景的专门化版本：对偶结构天然只容'一/异'两角，检验即穷举。代价与极限：'一异皆不成'依赖对'一'与'异'的日常语义，若对手把'关系性存在'本身当作第三种范畴（如现代关系实在论），此法需升级为对'关系范畴'的审查；且在实践中极易被误用为'取消一切区分'的含混主义——龙树的刀只拆实体化，不拆分位（世俗谛中燃者与柴仍然各司其位）。
modes.domain_en: Many chapters of the Mulamadhyamakakarika are generated by one operation: take a pair of mutually dependent concepts (burner and combustible, mover and going, agent and deed, self and aggregates) and first ask 'are they identical?'—if so, the distinction vanishes (the burner is the fuel, the act of burning loses its agent-patient articulation; if the self is the aggregates, the self dies with each aggregate and cannot be established). Then ask 'are they different?'—if different, they are utterly unrelated (a burner apart from fuel burns nothing; a self apart from the aggregates has no tie to body or mind, and practice and liberation lose their object). Both fail, so behind the 'relation' stands no substantial bearer—not cancelling the relation itself (conventionally fire burns and people practice), but cancelling the reading that reifies the relation into two (or one) intrinsically-natured things. This blade is the specialization of the tetralemma (M-NAG-002) to dual-structure scenes: a paired structure admits only the 'one/different' corners, so testing exhausts the field. Costs and limits: 'neither one nor different' rests on the ordinary semantics of identity and difference; an opponent who makes 'relational being' itself a third category (as modern relational realism does) forces an upgrade to scrutinizing the category of relation; and in practice the blade is easily misused as a vague 'abolish all distinctions'—Nagarjuna's knife removes reification, not distinction (conventionally burner and fuel keep their stations).
modes.definition_zh: 概念分析方法/对任何相依对偶逐一检验'是一'与'是异'并证明皆不成——同则失分位、异则失依存，拆除关系背后的实体承担者而不取消关系本身
modes.definition_en: Conceptual-analysis methodology/test 'identical' and 'different' on any dependent pair and show both fail—identity destroys the distinction, difference destroys the dependence; remove the substantial bearer behind the relation without cancelling the relation itself
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第10品观燃可燃、第2品观去来、第14品观和合、第18品观我法（我与蕴一异俱不成）、第20品观因果
key_concepts: 一异检验 the one/many test（对偶结构的穷举审查）
同则失分位 identity destroys distinction（是一则能所混一，动作失去结构）
异则失依存 difference destroys dependence（是异则两物无关，关系失去可能）
实体承担者不成立 no substantial bearer（关系存在而承担者空）
拆执不拆位 remove reification, not distinction（世俗层面分位照常）
modes.key_quote_zh: 若燃是可燃，作作者则一；若燃异可燃，离可燃有燃。
modes.key_quote_en: If the burning is the combustible, agent and act are one; if the burning is different from the combustible, it would burn apart from fuel.
process_zh: 识别对象中的相依对偶结构：能-所、整体-部分、主体-属性、因-果——列出对偶双方
检验'是一'：若双方同一，其分位与功能是否消失？——通常消失（主体与对象混一，结构瓦解），故'是一'不成
检验'是异'：若双方彻底相异而无关，依存关系是否还能成立？——通常不成立（离彼则此无用），故'是异'不成
拆除实体化：宣告'关系真实、实体承担者不成立'——在世俗层保留关系运作，在究竟层拒绝将其读作两个或一个自性物
process_en: Identify the dependent pair in the object: agent-patient, whole-part, subject-property, cause-effect—name both sides
Test identity: if the two are one, do their stations and functions vanish?—usually yes (agent and patient merge, structure collapses), so identity fails
Test difference: if the two are utterly unrelated, can the dependence still hold?—usually not (apart from the other, this is idle), so difference fails

Remove the reification: declare 'the relation is real, the substantial bearer is not established'—keep the relation working conventionally while refusing, ultimately, to read it as two or one intrinsically-natured things
representative_cases_zh: 观燃可燃品：燃者与可燃柴'一异俱不成'——全书最完整的一异检验示范，后世以'刀与斫、火与薪'反复重演
观我法品：'我'与五蕴一异俱不成——佛教无我论证的标准形态，被《入中论》七相推求精致化
观去来品：去者与去法一异俱破——对'动作主体'的实体性直觉的第一课，运动学上'现在去'不可得的著名分析
representative_cases_en: The examination of fire and fuel: burner and combustible are neither identical nor different—the fullest demonstration of the test, replayed ever after as 'knife and cutting, flame and firewood'

The examination of self and aggregates: the self is neither identical with nor different from the five aggregates—the standard form of the Buddhist no-self argument, refined into Candrakirti's sevenfold analysis
The examination of going: the mover and the going are both dissolved—the first lesson on the substantiality of 'agent of an action,' with the famous analysis that 'present going' cannot be found
modern_applications_zh: 组织架构实体化诊断：'部门'与'人'、'岗位'与'能力'常被实体化为自性物——一异检验可拆解'市场部（异于个人）'与'市场部即张三（同一）'两种执，回到关系性安立
产品一体化 vs 拆分的战略检验：'软硬一体'（一）与'彻底解耦'（异）两极都不成立时，说明应回到依存关系的具体条件设计——封闭生态与彻底开放是同一刀下的不同安立
心理边界咨询：'我与我的情绪是一'（被情绪吞没）与'我与情绪完全相异'（压抑隔离）两俱不成——健康的安立是'情绪依条件而起、与我依存相关而非同一'，龙树框架给出中道的表述
modern_applications_en: Diagnosing organizational reification: 'department' and 'person,' 'role' and 'competence' get reified into intrinsically-natured things—the one/different test dissolves both 'marketing is other than individuals' and 'marketing is Zhang San,' returning to relational establishment

Strategic testing of integration vs. unbundling: when 'integrated hardware-software' (one) and 'total decoupling' (different) both fail, the answer lies in designing the concrete conditions of dependence—closed ecosystem and total openness are different establishments under the same blade

Boundary counseling: 'I am my emotion' (being swallowed) and 'my emotion is wholly other' (suppression) both fail—the healthy establishment is 'emotion arises depending on conditions, related to me by dependence yet not identical'; Nagarjuna's frame gives the middle-way formulation
related_modes: M-NAG-002（四句破法——一异破是四句在对偶场景的专门化：对偶天然只容两角）
M-NAG-001（缘起归空法——一异俱不成正是'依起无自性'的对偶形态：关系依起而立，故无实体承担者）
M-SHA-002（商羯罗·梵我同一法——反向来向对照：商羯罗把'我与梵'判为一（同一），龙树把'我与蕴'判为不一不异——同一命题上'判一'与'破一异'的正面对照）
M-IBR-001（伊本·路世德·双真法——远缘对照：伊本·路世德以'哲学与宗教双真'化解一与多的张力，龙树以'不一不异'拆除张力双方的实体化——两种'不站极端'的技术路线）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 方法的精致者——七相推求（一、异、能依、所依、具有、积聚、形状）把二角检验扩展为七角
representative_figures.relation_en: the refiner—the sevenfold analysis (identity, difference, basis, dependent, possession, aggregation, shape) extends the two-corner test to seven

representative_figures.relation_en: the counterpoint—the Parmenides likewise torments the theory of Forms with the one/many puzzle, but Plato saves the Forms by participation while Nagarjuna dissolves substance with both corners failing

name_zh: 因果批判方法论/对'生起'本身施加审查：自生、他生、共生、无因生四种生起方式逻辑上皆不成立——'诸法不自生，亦不从他生，不共不无因，是故知无生'
name_en: causal-critique methodology/submit 'arising' itself to scrutiny: arising from self, from other, from both, or from neither—all four are logically untenable—'things do not arise from themselves, nor from another, nor from both, nor without cause: thus know there is no arising'
category: 因果批判方法论/对'生起'本身施加审查：自生、他生、共生、无因生四种生起方式逻辑上皆不成立——'诸法不自生，亦不从他生，不共不无因，是故知无生'
modes.domain_zh: 《中论》第一品即以此四门审查'生'。自生（数论：果本在因中）不成立——若果已有，'生'无所生，且已有者再生则无穷倒退；他生（胜论：因中无果、异因生异果）不成立——若因果自性相异则彻底无关，如薪不生火而能生火则一切生一切；共生（自他和合）不成立——两过合具；无因生（自然外道）不成立——则因果律与修行皆溃。四门俱闭，结论不是'无事物'而是'无生'：生起是依起关系的世俗描述，不是自性物的产生事件。此论在中观传统中被称为'离一异'之外的另一组金刚四句，后来被月称判教为'应成派与他派'的分水岭（佛护以归谬用之，清辨以自续重构成三支论式，争论绵延千年）。代价与极限：四门审查的前提是'生'被理解为'自性物之生'——若对手接受'缘起之生'（世俗假名之生），四门的反驳力只在究竟层生效，不与二谛（M-NAG-004）配套则会滑入'看似否认一切发生'的误读；且对'他生'的驳回依赖'自性相异即无关'这个强前提，关系实在论者可以挑战它。
modes.domain_en: MMK's first chapter submits 'arising' to these four gates. Arising from self (the Samkhya: the effect pre-exists in the cause) fails—if the effect already exists, 'arising' produces nothing, and re-arising of what exists is infinite regress; arising from another (the Vaisesika: wholly new effect from a different cause) fails—if cause and effect differ in intrinsic nature they are unrelated, and if what is other can produce, anything could produce anything; arising from both fails doubly; causeless arising (the naturalists) fails—causation and practice would collapse. With all four gates shut, the conclusion is not 'no things' but 'no arising': arising is the conventional description of a dependence relation, not the production event of an intrinsic thing. In the Madhyamaka tradition these four stand as the other set of adamantine tetralems beside the one/many analysis; later tradition made them the watershed between Prasangika and Svatantrika (Buddhapalita using them as pure reductio, Bhavaviveka recasting them in autonomous syllogism—the debate ran a millennium). Costs and limits: the audit presupposes 'arising' understood as 'production of an intrinsic thing'—an opponent who accepts 'dependent arising' (conventional, designated arising) concedes the four gates only at the ultimate level, and without the two truths (M-NAG-004) the argument reads as denying that anything ever happens; and the refutation of 'other-arising' leans on the strong premise that difference in intrinsic nature entails unrelatedness, which a relational realist may contest.
modes.definition_zh: 因果批判方法论/审查'生起'本身：自生、他生、共生、无因生四门皆闭——结论是无自性物之'生'，生起只是依起关系的世俗描述
modes.definition_en: Causal-critique methodology/submit arising itself to scrutiny: from self, other, both, or causeless—four gates all shut; the conclusion is no arising of intrinsic things, arising being the conventional description of dependence
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第1品观因缘（'诸法不自生，亦不从他生，不共不无因'）；《七十空性论》论生住灭；《十二门论》观生门
key_concepts: 四门生 the four gates of arising（自生/他生/共生/无因生的穷举）
自生无穷倒退 self-arising regress（已有者再生，生无所生）
他生无关障碍 other-arising unrelatedness（因果自性异则一切生一切）
无生 no-arising（生是依起的世俗描述而非自性事件）
归谬与自续之争 prasanga vs svatantrika（四门论证的两种使用方式）
modes.key_quote_zh: 诸法不自生，亦不从他生，不共不无因，是故知无生。
modes.key_quote_en: Things do not arise from themselves, nor from another, nor from both, nor without cause—therefore know that there is no arising.
process_zh: 把'X 产生于 Y'的因果主张分解为四种可能结构：X 本在 Y 中（自生）、X 与 Y 自性相异（他生）、两者结合（共生）、无需因（无因生）
逐门施加归谬：自生则生无所生且再生无穷；他生则自性相异即无关，一切应生一切；共生则两过并具；无因则因果与修行皆溃
宣告四门俱闭后的结论：'无生'——不是否认事件发生，而是否认'自性物被产生'这一本体论解读；生起重新安立为依起关系的世俗描述
与二谛配套：在世俗谛保留'生'的全部日常用法（生育、制造、发生），在究竟层注明其无自性——防止'无生'被读作虚无主义
process_en: Decompose the causal claim 'X arises from Y' into four possible structures: X pre-exists in Y (self), X differs in intrinsic nature from Y (other), both combined, no cause needed

Run reductio at each gate: self-arising produces nothing and regresses infinitely; other-arising makes unrelatedness entail everything-arising-from-anything; both fails doubly; causeless collapses causation and practice

Declare the conclusion with all gates shut: no arising—not a denial that events occur but a denial of the ontological reading 'an intrinsic thing is produced'; arising is re-established as the conventional description of dependence

Pair with the two truths: keep every everyday use of 'arising' conventionally (birth, manufacture, occurrence) while marking its lack of intrinsic nature ultimately—so 'no arising' is not read as nihilism
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》第一品的开门之作：对数论'自生'的'已有再生则无穷'归谬——用一个反问摧毁印度最精致的世代自性论
对他生的'一切生一切'归谬：若自性相异者可以互生，则稻种应生豆芽、黑暗亦应生光明——归谬推理的教科书示范
佛护与清辨的用法之争：同一组四门论证，佛护只用归谬（应成），清辨要求自立量（自续）——方法论争论本身成为中观思想史的主干线索
representative_cases_en: The opening engagement of chapter 1: the regress reductio against the Samkhya 'self-arising'—one question dismantles India's most refined theory of pre-existence

The 'anything from anything' reductio against other-arising: if difference in intrinsic nature permits production, rice seeds should sprout mung beans and darkness produce light—a textbook demonstration

The Buddhapalita-Bhavaviveka dispute over usage: the same four gates, used as pure reductio (Prasangika) or recast in autonomous syllogism (Svatantrika)—the methodological dispute became a main line in the history of Madhyamaka
modern_applications_zh: 创业'从0到1'话语审查：产品不是'无中生有'（无因生）、不是'创始人天赋自带'（自生）、不是'市场机会决定一切'（他生）——四门审查逼出'依起'的真话：成功依团队、时机、资本、技术条件的合和
科学发现的哲学表述：新理论不是从旧理论'他生'（范式不可通约时归谬即触发）、也不是'自生'（观察渗透理论）——把'发现'安立为依起事件，消解'天才史观'与'纯累积史观'的两极
因果推断的方法论自省：统计学因果推断永远只能给出依起关系（条件概率改变）而非'产生'——龙树四门是'相关非因果'直觉的形上学表述
modern_applications_en: Auditing the 'zero-to-one' startup discourse: products do not arise causelessly, are not born of founder genius (self), are not dictated by market opportunity alone (other)—the four gates force the truth of dependence: success arises from the convergence of team, timing, capital and technology

Philosophical formulation of scientific discovery: new theories neither arise 'from another' (the incommensurability reductio fires) nor 'from themselves' (observation is theory-laden)—establishing discovery as a dependence event dissolves both the genius view and the pure-accumulation view

Methodological self-audit of causal inference: statistical causality ever yields only dependence relations (changes in conditional probability), never 'production'—Nagarjuna's four gates are the metaphysical formulation of 'correlation is not causation'
related_modes: M-NAG-001（缘起归空法——无生论证是缘起归空的因果面：四门俱闭反证唯有依起）
M-NAG-002（四句破法——四门生是四句框架在'生起'问题上的专门化穷举）
M-AQU-001（阿奎那·五路证明法——反向来向对照：阿奎那从因果链回溯第一因，龙树审查因果链每一环的'生'而四门俱闭——同以因果为题，一个立第一因，一个拆生起本身）
M-UM-001（休谟·因果怀疑法——近缘对照：休谟拆因果的必然性而止于习惯性期待，龙树四门俱闭后把因果重新安立在世俗谛——拆解后'立什么'是两家分岔）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——《中论》开篇即以四门审查立法'无生'为中观的第一辩题
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—opened the Mulamadhyamakakarika by legislating 'no arising' through the four-gate audit as Madhyamaka's first thesis

representative_figures.relation_zh: 归谬用法的大师——只用归谬不立自宗，被月称尊为应成派的真正立脚点
representative_figures.relation_en: the master of reductio usage—refuting without establishing his own position, honored by Candrakirti as the true footing of the Prasangika

representative_figures.relation_zh: 自续用法的大师——把四门重构为自立量三支论式，触发千年方法论之争并使论证标准更严
representative_figures.relation_en: the master of autonomous usage—recasting the four gates in independent syllogism, triggering the millennium dispute and sharpening the standards of argument

name_zh: 实践方法论/在一切概念极端之间行持而不居边：不堕常断、不一不异——中道不是'中间点'，而是对两极共同预设（自性见）的放弃：'离有无二边，行于中道'
name_en: practical methodology/act between all conceptual extremes without taking a side: avoiding eternalism and annihilationism, identity and difference—the middle is not a midpoint but the abandonment of the presupposition both extremes share (the view of intrinsic nature)
category: 实践方法论/在一切概念极端之间行持而不居边：不堕常断、不一不异——中道不是'中间点'，而是对两极共同预设（自性见）的放弃：'离有无二边，行于中道'
modes.domain_zh: 中观之名由此而来。龙树的中道不是亚里士多德式的'两极之间的适度'（勇敢是鲁莽与怯懦之间的中间点——仍在同一尺度上取值），而是对尺度本身的放下：常与断两极共同预设'有自性之物'（常执它永存，断执它灭尽），看出这个共同预设，两极同时脱落——行持落在'依起'上：事物依缘而生灭，故非常（无不变自性可执常）亦非断（依起相续，非一灭永灭）。此法把认识论结论转化为实践姿态：在伦理上不堕'道德虚无'（断）与'道德绝对'（常）——规范依缘施设而有效，且无永恒自性可执；在行动上不堕'宿命'（一切决定）与'任意'（一切随机）——行为是条件合和中的一项条件，参与而不主导。观十二因缘品把此法接到修行：无明灭则行灭的还灭链，正是'依起故可转'的实践面。代价与极限：'中道'极易被庸俗化为折中主义（各打五十大板）——龙树的中道不在两极之间取值，而是拆除两极的坐标轴；判别真中道与折中主义的试金石是'是否触到共同预设'，这在实践中依赖洞察力而非程序。
modes.domain_en: The school's name comes from here. Nagarjuna's middle way is not the Aristotelian 'mean between extremes' (courage as the midpoint of recklessness and cowardice—still a value on one scale) but the laying down of the scale itself: eternalism and annihilationism share the presupposition of 'an intrinsically-natured thing' (the eternalist clings to its permanence, the annihilationist to its ending); seeing the shared presupposition, both extremes fall away together—and practice lands on 'dependence': things arise and cease depending on conditions, hence not eternal (no unchanging nature to cling to) and not annihilated (the continuity of dependence is not a once-for-all perishing). The method converts an epistemological conclusion into a practical stance: ethically, neither moral nihilism (annihilation) nor moral absolutism (eternalism)—norms are valid as conditioned designations and hold no eternal essence; in action, neither fatalism (all determined) nor arbitrariness (all random)—deeds are one condition in a convergence of conditions, participating without dominating. The examination of the twelve links ties the method to practice: the chain 'with ignorance ceased, formations cease' is precisely the practical face of 'because dependence, therefore transformable.' Costs and limits: 'middle way' vulgarizes easily into split-the-difference compromise—Nagarjuna's middle takes no value between the poles but removes their coordinate axis; the touchstone distinguishing true middle from compromise is 'does it touch the shared presupposition,' which in practice depends on insight rather than procedure.
modes.definition_zh: 实践方法论/中道不是两极之间的折中点，而是对两极共同预设（自性见）的放弃——看出两极同犯一错，两极同时脱落，行持落在依起上
modes.definition_en: Practical methodology/the middle way is not a compromise point between extremes but the abandonment of their shared presupposition (the view of intrinsic nature)—seeing both poles commit the same error, both fall away, and practice lands on dependence
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第1品归敬颂（'离有无二边'）、第15品观有无、第24品观四谛（'亦是中道义'）、第26品观十二因缘
key_concepts: 中道 madhyama pratipad（对共同预设的放弃而非折中）
常断二边 eternalism and annihilationism（有见/无见两极）
共同预设检验 shared-presupposition test（两极同犯'自性见'）
依起而行 acting on dependence（参与条件而不主导条件）
还灭链 the ceasing chain（无明灭则行灭——依起故可转的实践面）
modes.key_quote_zh: 不生亦不灭，不常亦不断，不一亦不异，不来亦不出——能说是因缘，善灭诸戏论，我稽首礼佛。
modes.key_quote_en: Neither arising nor ceasing, neither permanent nor annulled, neither one nor different, neither coming nor going—such is dependent origination, the appeasement of all proliferation; to that Buddha I bow.
process_zh: 把眼前的立场冲突表述为一对极端：常/断、一/异、来/去、决定/随机——确认两极的表述方式
寻找两极的共同预设：两极共享的那个未审查前提是什么？（通常是'存在自性物'或'存在唯一正确的本体描述'）
放弃共同预设而非选边：宣告两极在'有自性'坐标上同时不成立，把行动安立在依起关系上——既非常亦非断的新描述
转入行持：在规范上（依缘施设而有效的伦理）、行动上（条件合和中的参与项）、修持上（还灭链的逐环松动）落实'依起'姿态
process_en: Formulate the conflict as a pair of extremes: eternal/annihilated, one/different, coming/going, determined/random—state both poles' terms
Hunt the shared presupposition: what unexamined premise do both poles share? (usually 'an intrinsically-natured thing exists' or 'one correct ontological description exists')
Abandon the presupposition, not one pole: declare both poles untenable on the 'intrinsic nature' axis and establish action on dependence—a description neither eternal nor annihilated

Carry into practice: in norms (ethics valid as conditioned designation), in action (a participating condition within a convergence), in cultivation (loosening the ceasing chain link by link)—the stance of dependence
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》归敬颂的'八不'总纲：不生不灭、不常不断、不一不异、不来不去——全书立场的浓缩宣言，中道行持的纲领文本
观十二因缘品：无明灭则行灭……生灭则老死灭——把中道接到还灭实践：既然是依起链而非宿命，逐环可松动
对'恶取空'的预防性警告：'不能正观空者，钝根则自害'——中道行持的反面教材：把空当作放弃一切行动的理由即堕断边
representative_cases_en: The eight negations of the homage verse: no arising, no ceasing, no permanence, no annihilation, no identity, no difference, no coming, no going—the condensed manifesto and program text of middle-way practice

The examination of the twelve links: with ignorance ceased, formations cease ... with birth ceased, aging-and-death cease—the middle way wired into practice: being a dependence chain and not fate, every link can be loosened

The preventive warning against 'wicked emptiness': 'who observes emptiness wrongly, the dull destroy themselves'—the negative exhibit of the method: taking emptiness as grounds to abandon all action falls into annihilationism
modern_applications_zh: 政策设计的'第三轴'思考：计划经济/自由市场、集权/分权等两极争论，先找共同预设（'存在唯一正确的制度本体'），放弃后转向条件设计——哈耶克与科斯的方案在龙树框架里都是'依起安立'的样本
冲突调解的中道技术：把'你错我对'表述为两极，引导双方看见共同预设（如'零和'假设）——放弃预设而非各让一步，和解因此不是折中而是升维
个人决策的极端审计：'全押'与'不动'两极共同预设'机会是自性物'（要么必成要么永失）——看出依起（条件可造、后果可分批承担），行动落在中间动态而非端点
modern_applications_en: The 'third axis' in policy design: in plan-versus-market, centralization-versus-devolution, first find the shared presupposition ('one correct institutional ontology exists'); abandoning it turns attention to condition-design—Hayek's and Coase's schemes are both samples of 'establishing on dependence' in Nagarjuna's frame

The middle-way technique in mediation: formulate 'you are wrong, I am right' as poles and guide both sides to see the shared presupposition (say, a zero-sum assumption)—abandoning the presupposition rather than each conceding a step, settlement becomes dimensional, not a split of differences

Extreme auditing in personal decisions: 'all-in' and 'hold still' share the presupposition that 'the opportunity is an intrinsic thing' (either bound to succeed or lost forever)—seeing dependence (conditions can be made, costs can be staged), action lands in the dynamic middle, not an endpoint
related_modes: M-NAG-001（缘起归空法——中道的正面表述：依起即中道，空假名即是中道义）
M-NAG-002（四句破法——中道的辩证面：四句俱遣之后所行即是中道）
M-AR-001（亚里士多德·中庸法——近缘对照：亚氏中道在同一尺度上取适度值，龙树中道拆除尺度本身——'取中间值'与'弃坐标轴'是两种中道的分岔）
M-NER-008（聂鲁达·合唱总谱法——跨域对照：聂鲁达在个人抒情与集体政治两极间拒绝选边而以'合唱总谱'兼收两者，与'放弃预设而非选边'共享超越两极的姿态）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——以八不归敬颂立法'中道即缘起'，学派因此得名中观
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—legislated 'the middle way is dependent origination' in the eight-negation homage verse, giving the school its name Madhyamaka

representative_figures.relation_zh: 教义源头——初转法轮'离苦乐二边'的中道原初表述，龙树把它从伦理升格为本体论
representative_figures.relation_en: the source of the doctrine—the Buddha's original 'leaving both extremes of indulgence and mortification,' which Nagarjuna elevated from ethics to ontology

representative_figures.relation_zh: 对照系——中庸的适度值方案与中观的弃坐标方案并行于两大文明，是'两种中道'的经典对位
representative_figures.relation_en: the contrast system—the Aristotelian mean and the Madhyamaka abandonment-of-axis run in parallel across two civilizations, the classic counterpoint of 'two middle ways'

name_zh: 元方法论/把方法论自身的结论再次作为审查对象：'空'若被执为实体、被执为新真理，即成'空见'——与大误解同罪：'若复见有空，诸佛所不化'——任何体系最终必须吞下自身
name_en: metamethodology/make the methodology's own conclusion the next object of scrutiny: if 'emptiness' is reified or held as a new truth it becomes the 'view of emptiness'—guilty of the same error as the great misconceptions: 'one who then sees emptiness as a view is beyond the Buddhas' healing'—any system must finally swallow itself
category: 元方法论/把方法论自身的结论再次作为审查对象：'空'若被执为实体、被执为新真理，即成'空见'——与大误解同罪：'若复见有空，诸佛所不化'——任何体系最终必须吞下自身
modes.domain_zh: 这是《中论》最深的一刀，也是龙树体系免于自我悖论的关键装置。任何批判方法都面临'特准恳求'（special pleading）指控：你用理由拆解一切立场，你的'一切皆空'凭什么豁免？龙树在第13品正面立法：空是'对治'（pratipaksa）——如病愈后药须弃；'空'依'执有'而立，执有既去，空亦不留。第24品给出逻辑表述（'若有不空法，则应有空法；实无不空法，何得有空法'）：'空'是依'不空'这个对立面而施设的概念——既然一切法皆依起（无有不空者），'空'就失去了对立面，成为无指称的假名。这使中观成为自洽的自否定系统：它唯一的主张是'连这个主张也不可执'。后世的'空空'（藏传'空性之空'）、禅宗'逢佛杀佛'、维特根斯坦'登楼撤梯'都是此法的变奏。代价与极限：自否定系统在传播中极不稳定——'连空也不执'立即被执为新的更高真理（二阶执取），需无限递归的提醒；且'吞下自身'使体系无法提供最终裁决标准，留下'如何避免滑向什么都可以'的持续张力，月称之后'名言有'的重建正是在处理这个问题。
modes.domain_en: This is the deepest cut in the Mulamadhyamakakarika and the device that spares Nagarjuna's system self-contradiction. Every critical method faces the charge of special pleading: you dismantle all positions with reasons—why is your 'all is empty' exempt? Nagarjuna legislates in chapter 13: emptiness is a remedy (pratipaksa)—as medicine is discarded after the cure; 'emptiness' stands in dependence on the clinging to 'being,' and when the clinging goes, emptiness does not stay. Chapter 24 gives the logical formulation ('if there were anything non-empty, emptiness could exist; since nothing non-empty exists, how could emptiness exist?'): 'emptiness' is a concept imputed on its opposite 'non-empty'—since all things depend (none is non-empty), emptiness loses its opposite and becomes a designation without referent. Madhyamaka is thereby a self-consistent self-negating system: its only claim is that even this claim must not be clung to. The later 'emptiness of emptiness,' the Chan 'meet the Buddha and kill the Buddha,' Wittgenstein's 'throw away the ladder after climbing'—all variations of this method. Costs and limits: self-negating systems are unstable in transmission—'cling not even to emptiness' is instantly clung to as a higher truth (second-order clinging), requiring endless recursive reminders; and 'swallowing itself' leaves the system no final criterion of adjudication, a standing tension over how to avoid sliding into 'anything goes'—the post-Candrakirti rebuilding of 'conventional existence' addressed exactly this.
modes.definition_zh: 元方法论/把方法论自身结论再次作为审查对象：空依执有而立，执有既去空亦不留——'若复见有空，诸佛所不化'：体系必须吞下自身方为自洽
modes.definition_en: Metamethodology/make the methodology's own conclusion the next object of scrutiny: emptiness stands on the clinging to being and departs when the clinging departs—'one who then sees emptiness as a view is beyond healing': a system is consistent only when it swallows itself
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第13品观行（'大圣说空法，为离诸见故'）、第24品观四谛（'实无不空法，何得有空法'）、第18品观我法（'有无既无故，戏论息'）
key_concepts: 空见 the view of emptiness（把空执为实体与新真理的顶层错误）
对治即弃 remedy then discard（空如药，病愈药弃）
无对立面的假名 designation without opposite（空依'不空'施设，不空既无则空无指称）
自否定系统 self-negating system（唯一主张是'连此主张也不可执'）
登楼撤梯 ladder-throwing（方法论用毕即弃的姿态）
modes.key_quote_zh: 大圣说空法，为离诸见故；若复见有空，诸佛所不化。
modes.key_quote_en: The great sage taught emptiness to free us from all views; one who then sees emptiness as a view is beyond the healing of the Buddhas.
process_zh: 识别体系的顶层概念：本方法依赖的最核心、最不可让渡的那个词是什么？（如'空'、'理性'、'效率'）
审查顶层概念的施设结构：它依什么对立面或什么语境而立？——找到'空'依'不空'式的对称项
执行自噬：证明当体系的目标达成（执有既去、问题已解），顶层概念失去对立面而无指称——必须随境况一起放下
建立弃用条款：把'此概念用毕即弃'写进体系自身（如维特根斯坦的撤梯比喻），并设计对'二阶执取'（把弃用也执为真理）的持续提醒机制
process_en: Identify the system's top-level concept: the most central, least negotiable word on which the method rests (say, 'emptiness,' 'reason,' 'efficiency')
Audit the concept's imputation structure: on what opposite or context does it stand?—find the symmetrical term ('emptiness' on 'non-empty')

Execute the self-consumption: show that when the system's goal is achieved (clinging gone, problem solved), the top-level concept loses its opposite and its referent—it must be laid down with the situation

Install a sunset clause: write 'this concept is discarded after use' into the system itself (as Wittgenstein's ladder), with a standing reminder mechanism against second-order clinging (clinging to the discarding itself)
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》第13品'空如对治药'的立法：空为破执而设，执破则空不当留——'若复见有空，诸佛所不化'成为整个大乘传统的自检格言
第24品的逻辑表述：'实无不空法，何得有空法'——'空'因失去对立面而成为无指称假名，自否定获得严格论证形式
禅宗'逢佛杀佛'与佛陀筏喻（法尚应舍，何况非法）：筏喻是此法的原始版本，禅宗将其推向戏剧化极致
representative_cases_en: The chapter-13 legislation of emptiness as remedy: emptiness is set up to break clinging and must not remain once clinging breaks—'one who sees emptiness as a view is beyond the Buddhas' healing' became the self-audit maxim of the whole Mahayana

The chapter-24 logical formulation: 'since nothing non-empty exists, how could emptiness exist?'—emptiness becomes a referentless designation for losing its opposite, the self-negation given strict argumentative form
The Chan 'meet the Buddha and kill the Buddha' and the Buddha's raft simile (the Dharma itself is to be let go, let alone what is not-Dharma)—the primal version, dramatized to the extreme by Chan
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革的'工具退役'制度：数字化转型、OKR、敏捷都是'对治药'——制度上写明退役条件（如'OKR 成熟即转入常规管理'），防止工具本身成为新官僚教条
科学方法论的自省：'可证伪性'标准自身的适用边界（数学、历史学是否豁免）——波普尔体系需要龙树式自噬：方法论标准不得把自己豁免于审查
AI 安全的对齐递归问题：'对齐目标'本身可能被错执（reward hacking 是'把药执为食'的机器版本）——目标用毕即弃、分层递归审查，是'空亦复空'的技术翻译
modern_applications_en: Sunset clauses for organizational tools: digital transformation, OKR and agile are all remedies—institutionalize retirement conditions ('once OKR matures, fold into routine management') so tools do not become the new bureaucratic dogma

Self-audit of scientific methodology: the applicability of 'falsifiability' itself (do mathematics and history get exemptions?)—Popper's system needs the Nagarjunian swallow: a methodological standard may not exempt itself from scrutiny

The recursive problem in AI alignment: alignment objectives can be mis-clung to (reward hacking is the machine version of 'clinging to the medicine as food')—objectives discarded after use, with layered recursive review, is 'emptiness of emptiness' in technical translation
related_modes: M-NAG-001（缘起归空法——自噬的上游：空依缘起而立，故空亦复空）
M-NAG-002（四句破法——'无宗无过'原则是自噬的论证形态：不立宗则无可被驳）

M-WZT-010（武则天·无字碑留白法——反向对照：武则天以无字碑拒绝为自己撰写定论、把解释权交给后世，龙树以自噬拆除一切锚点——两种'不为自己立言'的收束策略）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——第13、24品立法'空亦复空'，使中观成为史上最自洽的自否定系统
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—legislated 'emptiness of emptiness' in chapters 13 and 24, making Madhyamaka the most self-consistent self-negating system in history

representative_figures.relation_zh: 反向对照——无字碑拒绝为自己撰写定论、把解释权交给后世，与'体系不为自己立宗'共享'不以断言自封'的姿态
representative_figures.relation_en: the counterpoint—the blank stele refuses any verdict on itself, handing interpretation to posterity, sharing with 'no thesis for the system' the posture of sealing nothing by assertion

representative_figures.relation_zh: 方法的戏剧化继承者——'本来无一物'把'空亦复空'压缩进一句偈，连'空'也不立
representative_figures.relation_en: the dramatic inheritor—'originally there is not one thing' compresses the method into one verse, establishing not even emptiness

name_zh: 认知收敛方法论/概念增殖（prapanca，戏论）是痛苦的认知根源——语言在'有无'等概念轴上无限繁殖，把依起的流动切制成实体化的碎片；止息之道不是压抑概念，而是看出戏论依执取而运转
name_en: cognitive-convergence methodology/conceptual proliferation (prapanca) is the cognitive root of suffering—language proliferates endlessly on axes like is/is-not, slicing the flow of dependence into reified fragments; the way of ceasing is not to suppress concepts but to see that proliferation runs on clinging
category: 认知收敛方法论/概念增殖（prapanca，戏论）是痛苦的认知根源——语言在'有无'等概念轴上无限繁殖，把依起的流动切制成实体化的碎片；止息之道不是压抑概念，而是看出戏论依执取而运转
modes.domain_zh: 《中论》第18品的收尾立法把全书从逻辑学转向认知治疗。prapanca（戏论/概念增殖）指心在'有无'、'一异'、'生死'等概念轴上不断制造立场、立场生立场——语言不是在描述世界而是在繁殖实体化的碎片。龙树诊断：戏论的原动力是执取（upadana）——因为想'占有'某物，才把它切成有边界的自性物；无执的心不切片。所以止息戏论不是话疗法（说更少的话）而是执疗法（松动占有欲）——'戏论灭故，戏论所依之执亦灭'描述的是一个双向刹车：执取驱动增殖，增殖反过来巩固执取，松动任一环整套松动。此法给全书以治疗学的收口：前面各品的归谬不是智力游戏，而是让对手在概念繁殖的每一分支都撞墙，撞到'概念的墙太多了'的那一瞬，增殖自然息止——沉默不是无话可说，而是增殖停止后的自然状态。'有无既无故，戏论息'是全书的治疗学总结。代价与极限：'止息'无法被命题化传达（一命题化即又一戏论），传承只能靠示范与设计体验；且区分'有益的建构性思维'与'病态的戏论增殖'没有形式标准——龙树以'是否依执取'为准绳，这在应用中依赖自省的精度。
modes.domain_en: The closing legislation of chapter 18 turns the whole work from logic into cognitive therapy. Prapanca (proliferation) is the mind endlessly manufacturing positions on axes of is/is-not, one/many, life/death—position breeding position—language not describing the world but multiplying reified fragments. Nagarjuna's diagnosis: the motor of proliferation is clinging (upadana)—because one wants to 'possess' something, one slices it into a bounded intrinsic thing; the unclinging mind does not slice. Ceasing proliferation is therefore not talk-therapy (fewer words) but clinging-therapy (loosening possessiveness)—'when proliferation ceases, the clinging on which it stands ceases' describes a two-way brake: clinging drives proliferation and proliferation entrenches clinging; loosen either and the whole loosens. The method gives the work its therapeutic close: the earlier reductios are not intellectual games but a way of letting the opponent hit walls at every branch of conceptual proliferation until, at the moment 'there are too many walls,' proliferation stops of itself—silence is not having nothing to say but the natural state after proliferation stops. 'With being and non-being gone, proliferation ceases' is the therapeutic summing-up of the whole work. Costs and limits: 'ceasing' cannot be conveyed propositionally (a proposition is more proliferation); transmission works only by demonstration and designed experience; and there is no formal criterion separating constructive thinking from pathological proliferation—Nagarjuna's gauge is 'does it run on clinging,' which in application depends on the precision of self-examination.
modes.definition_zh: 认知收敛方法论/概念增殖是痛苦的认知根源，其原动力是执取——止息之道不是少说话而是松动占有欲：执取驱动增殖，增殖巩固执取，双向刹车
modes.definition_en: Cognitive-convergence methodology/conceptual proliferation is the cognitive root of suffering, powered by clinging—the way of ceasing is not fewer words but loosened possessiveness: clinging drives proliferation and proliferation entrenches clinging, a two-way brake
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》第18品观我法（'有无既无故，戏论息'）、第25品观涅槃（'戏论灭'之定义）、《六十如理论》论戏论与寂灭
key_concepts: 戏论 prapanca（概念在有无等轴上的无限增殖）
增殖-执取双向刹车 the proliferation-clinging brake（任一环松动整套松动）
执取切片 clinging slices（占有欲把流动切成实体碎片）
治疗学收口 the therapeutic close（归谬撞墙到增殖自停）
沉默即增殖停止 silence as cessation（非无话可说，是自然状态）
modes.key_quote_zh: 有无既无故，戏论亦息——诸法实相者，心行言语断。
modes.key_quote_en: With being and non-being gone, proliferation ceases—the true nature of things is where thought and speech are cut off.
process_zh: 识别增殖状态：检查当前思维是否在少数概念轴（对错、得失、有无）上反复生成立场——增殖的征兆是'新立场总在旧立场上繁殖'
定位驱动源：问'这个概念游戏在为哪种占有欲服务？'——想赢的辩论、怕失去的身份、想固化的利益，戏论背后总有执取
松动执取而非压制概念：对驱动源做处理（承认失去的可能、撤销身份绑定），让增殖失去能源——不与念头搏斗，断其供给
验证止息：增殖停止的标志不是'无观点'而是'观点不再自我繁殖'——仍可言说、仍可行动，但每一句话都是工具而非新阵地
process_en: Recognize proliferation: check whether thought is endlessly spawning positions on a few axes (right/wrong, gain/loss, is/is-not)—the symptom is 'new positions breeding on old ones'
Locate the driver: ask 'which possessiveness does this concept game serve?'—a debate to win, an identity defended, an interest to freeze; behind proliferation there is always clinging
Loosen the clinging, not the concepts: treat the driver (acknowledge possible loss, unbind identity) so proliferation loses its fuel—do not fight the thoughts, cut the supply
Verify cessation: proliferation has stopped not when 'no views remain' but when views no longer breed—one still speaks and acts, but every sentence is a tool, not a new position
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》第18品的'心行言语断'：诸法实相被定义为概念活动的止息处——全书归谬在治疗学上的总收口
第25品对涅槃的界定：'戏论灭'即寂灭——涅槃不是另一个世界而是增殖停止的这个心，治疗学意义的终极化
归谬的方法学设计：让对手在每一分支撞墙而非直接告知答案——增殖自然息止的'体验设计'，是认知行为疗法'苏格拉底式提问'的千年先声
representative_cases_en: Chapter 18's 'where thought and speech are cut off': the true nature of things defined as where conceptual activity stops—the therapeutic closing of all the earlier reductios
Chapter 25's definition of nirvana as 'the ceasing of proliferation'—nirvana is not another world but this very mind with proliferation stopped, the ultimate statement of the therapeutic reading

The methodological design of reductio: letting the opponent hit walls at every branch rather than telling the answer—a designed experience of natural cessation, a millennia-early ancestor of Socratic questioning in cognitive therapy
modern_applications_zh: 信息过载与注意力管理：刷屏、立场站队、无限争论是 prapanca 的当代形态——龙树诊断说'少刷'不是解法，'松动身份绑定'（观点不等于我）才是断供
组织会议治理：会议中立场繁殖（每个观点引出三个反驳）的驱动常是'位置保卫'——改变激励（谁先认错谁得分）即断其能源，比'限时发言'更根本
谈判与冲突降温：识别对方增殖的驱动执取（面子、先例、恐惧），处理执取而非纠缠论点——'论点降温'常常无效而'执取安抚'立竿见影
modern_applications_en: Information overload and attention management: doom-scrolling, taking sides, endless arguing are prapanca today—Nagarjuna's diagnosis says 'scroll less' is no cure; 'unbinding identity' (opinions are not me) cuts the supply

Meeting governance: the driver of position-breeding in meetings (each view drawing three rebuttals) is often 'position defense'—change the incentives (whoever concedes first scores) to cut the fuel, more fundamental than time limits

Negotiation and de-escalation: identify the clinging driving the other side's proliferation (face, precedent, fear) and treat the clinging rather than the arguments—cooling arguments often fails while soothing clinging works at once

M-NAG-008（空亦复空法——自噬与止息是同一装置的两面：概念用毕即弃，增殖失去燃料）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——第18品立法'戏论灭故执亦灭'，把中观从逻辑学收口为认知治疗学
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—legislated in chapter 18 that 'when proliferation ceases the clinging ceases,' closing Madhyamaka from logic into cognitive therapy

representative_figures.relation_zh: 教义源头——'戏论'概念出于早期文本（prapanca），龙树把它升格为整套治疗学的核心机制
representative_figures.relation_en: the source of the doctrine—'proliferation' appears in early texts (papanca), which Nagarjuna elevated into the core mechanism of the whole therapy

representative_figures.relation_zh: 现代平行——'思维认同是痛苦的根源'与'戏论依执取而运转'几乎同构，但缺乏龙树的归谬工程学
representative_figures.relation_en: the modern parallel—'identification with thought is the root of suffering' is nearly isomorphic with 'proliferation runs on clinging,' though lacking Nagarjuna's reductio engineering

name_zh: 传承收束方法论/以感恩与传承收束一生事业：龙树自认无新立法（'我稽首礼佛'——一切归功于佛陀），把自己定位为护教者而非立法者；体系不系于一人——弟子续其辩，译家传其文，禅、净、天台皆奉其为'八宗共祖'
name_en: legacy-closure methodology/close a life's work with gratitude and transmission: Nagarjuna claims no new legislation ('to that Buddha I bow'—all credited to the Buddha), positioning himself as guardian rather than legislator; the system rests on no single man—his heir carried the disputation, translators carried the text, and Chan, Pure Land and Tiantai all honor him as 'common ancestor of eight schools'
category: 传承收束方法论/以感恩与传承收束一生事业：龙树自认无新立法（'我稽首礼佛'——一切归功于佛陀），把自己定位为护教者而非立法者；体系不系于一人——弟子续其辩，译家传其文，禅、净、天台皆奉其为'八宗共祖'
modes.domain_zh: 《中论》以归敬颂开篇、以礼赞收束——全书第一句与最后一节都不是立场陈述而是顶礼：'我稽首礼佛，善说寂灭法'。这不是修辞谦逊而是体系必然：既然'无宗无过'（M-NAG-002），龙树不能把自己的体系立为'龙树教'——唯一自洽的收束方式是把方法归还给源头（佛陀的缘起教），把自己定位为'护教者'而非'立法者'。此法与'空亦复空'（M-NAG-008）构成体系的收尾双装置：自噬拆掉自己的权威，感恩把权威归还传统——体系因此可以脱离创始人而存活。事实上确实如此：龙树身后中观由提婆、佛护、月称、清辨数代接续，经鸠摩罗什入汉地（三论宗）、经寂护入藏地（应成传统），禅宗以《楞伽》与'传灯'奉其为初祖或共祖，净土、天台、华严皆引其论——'千部论主'之名下，是一个真正不依赖本人的传承网络。传说层面，龙树之死亦成收束范本：为太子求其头而自愿施头，'以吉祥草叶断首'——把'色身可舍、法身传承'演成戏剧。代价与极限：感恩收束依赖后学的忠诚诠释——'八宗共祖'意味着八宗各自塑造自己需要的龙树（禅宗的、净土的、密教的龙树差异巨大），原创者在传承中失去解释权；且'无宗'姿态在论敌面前可能被读作虚弱（清辨即要求中观必须自立量）。
modes.domain_en: The Mulamadhyamakakarika opens with a homage and closes in praise—the first verse and the final section are not statements of position but bows: 'to that Buddha I bow, who well taught the peace of all proliferation.' This is not rhetorical modesty but systemic necessity: since 'no thesis, no fault' (M-NAG-002), Nagarjuna cannot establish his own system as 'the religion of Nagarjuna'—the only self-consistent closure is returning the method to its source (the Buddha's teaching of dependent origination) and positioning himself as guardian, not legislator. This method and 'emptiness of emptiness' (M-NAG-008) form the system's closing pair: self-consumption strips one's own authority, gratitude returns authority to tradition—and the system survives its founder. And so it proved: after Nagarjuna, Madhyamaka continued through Aryadeva, Buddhapalita, Candrakirti and Bhavaviveka; entered China through Kumarajiva (the Three Treatise school), Tibet through Santaraksita (the Prasangika tradition); the Chan school honored him as first or common ancestor through the Lankavatara and 'transmission of the lamp'; Pure Land, Tiantai and Huayan all cite his treatises—under the name 'author of a thousand treatises' stands a transmission network truly independent of the man. In legend his death became a closure exemplar: yielding his head willingly to a prince seeking it, severed 'with a blade of kusa grass'—the body surrenderable, the transmission imperishable, staged as drama. Costs and limits: gratitude-closure depends on successors' faithful interpretation—'common ancestor of eight schools' means eight schools each fashioning the Nagarjuna they need (the Chan, Pure Land and Tantric Nagarjunas differ greatly), the author losing interpretive authority in transmission; and the 'no thesis' stance may read as weakness before rivals—Bhavaviveka insisted Madhyamaka must establish its own syllogisms.
modes.definition_zh: 传承收束方法论/以感恩把权威归还源头、以传承使体系脱离创始人——自认护教者而非立法者，'我稽首礼佛'：最彻底的收束是把体系交出去
modes.definition_en: Legacy-closure methodology/return authority to the source through gratitude and let transmission free the system from its founder—claiming guardianship, not legislation; 'to that Buddha I bow': the most thorough closure is handing the system over
modes.source_chapter: 《中论》归敬颂与第27品收尾礼赞；《大智度论》自任'释迦文佛弟子'；《付法藏因缘传》龙树传（《楞伽经》授记'当来世中，当有比丘，龙树出世'）
key_concepts: 归敬即立法 homage as legislation（开篇顶礼是体系自定位的宣言）
护教者而非立法者 guardian, not legislator（方法归还源头，自免'立宗之过'）
传承网络 transmission network（弟子-译者-各宗的多路径接续）
八宗共祖 common ancestor of eight schools（被再诠释的代价与生命力）
施头传说 the yielding-head legend（色身可舍、法身传承的戏剧化收束）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我稽首礼佛，善灭诸戏论——不自立一宗，唯传佛所教。
modes.key_quote_en: To that Buddha I bow, who appeased all proliferation—I establish no school of my own, only transmit what the Buddha taught.
process_zh: 在体系完成时区分'创见'与'护持'：明确声明哪些是继承、哪些是显发——像龙树把'缘起'归还佛陀、把中观定位为'缘起本义的重申'
以感恩仪式替代自我加冕：用归敬、回向、致敬文本为体系开篇与收束——把注意力从'作者'导向'传承链'
铺设多路径传承：亲自培养接续者（提婆），把文本交给流通渠道（翻译、抄写、注疏许可），让体系不依赖任何单一载体
预演退场：像施头传说那样，把'个人可去、体系永续'演给后人看——创始人退场的姿态本身就是体系的一部分
process_en: At completion, separate 'innovation' from 'stewardship': state explicitly what is inherited and what is unfolded—like Nagarjuna returning 'dependent origination' to the Buddha and positioning Madhyamaka as the reaffirmation of its original meaning
Replace self-coronation with gratitude rites: open and close the system with homage, dedication and tribute—directing attention from 'author' to 'transmission chain'
Lay multi-path transmission: train successors in person (Aryadeva), commit the text to circulation (translation, copying, licensed commentary), so the system depends on no single carrier
Rehearse the exit: as in the yielding-head legend, stage 'the person may go, the system endures' for posterity—the founder's exit posture is itself part of the system
representative_cases_zh: 《中论》归敬颂：全书以'我稽首礼佛'开篇——不立'龙树学'而立'佛说缘起之重申'，体系自定位的第一文本
传承网络的实际运作：提婆续辩、佛护月称清辨各开一路、鸠摩罗什译入汉地开三论宗、寂护传入藏地开应成传统——'不系于一人'的千年实证
《楞伽经》授记与'八宗共祖'：授记文本把龙树预写进传承合法性，八宗各自再诠释——原创者失去解释权而体系获得超常生命力
representative_cases_en: The homage verse: the work opens 'to that Buddha I bow'—establishing not 'Nagarjunism' but 'the reaffirmation of the Buddha's dependent origination,' the founding text of the system's self-positioning

The transmission network at work: Aryadeva continued the disputation, Buddhapalita, Candrakirti and Bhavaviveka each opened a line, Kumarajiva translated it into China founding the Three Treatise school, Santaraksita carried it into Tibet founding the Prasangika tradition—a millennium-long proof of 'not resting on one man'

The Lankavatara prophecy and 'common ancestor of eight schools': the prophetic text pre-wrote Nagarjuna into transmission legitimacy, eight schools each reinterpreting him—the author lost interpretive authority and the system gained extraordinary vitality
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目交接：以'归还社区'替代'创始人品牌'——显式声明继承与创见、铺设多维护路径（文档、基金会、分叉许可），Linux 与龙树共享'体系不系于一人'的收束结构
学术谱系的感恩收束：论文以'本工作建立在XX传统之上'开篇、把方法归还传统——这不是客套而是免于'立宗之过'的学术自洽：立场越彻底，越需要谦逊的收束
家族与组织传承设计：创始人以'守护者而非所有者'自任（像龙树自任护教者），用仪式（归敬）与制度（多路径）双重铺设退场——退场姿态本身成为组织文化的一部分
modern_applications_en: Open-source succession: replace founder-brand with return-to-community—declare inheritance and innovation explicitly, lay multi-path maintenance (docs, foundation, fork licensing); Linux and Nagarjuna share the closure structure of 'the system not resting on one man'

Gratitude closure in academic lineage: open a paper with 'this work builds on the tradition of...' and return the method to tradition—not courtesy but scholarly self-consistency against the 'fault of thesis': the more radical the stance, the more humility the closure requires

Family and organizational succession design: the founder takes 'guardian, not owner' as self-description (as Nagarjuna claimed stewardship), laying the exit with ritual (homage) and institution (multi-path) in tandem—the exit posture itself becomes part of the culture
